purpose: Permit immediate transition from the already-running L13 clean-surface audit to the prospectively frozen adsorption-site ordering gate without recomputing the completed clean-surface matrix.
scientific_scope: mechanical handoff only; no scientific setting, threshold, model, pseudopotential, convergence rule, geometry rule, or kinetic input is changed

authoritative_current_audit.workflow: CO Cu111 PBE surface audit continuation extension v2

handoff_rules: Do not dispatch adsorption-site calculations unless the authoritative current-audit clean gate is CLEAN_SURFACE_PASS.
Do not rerun the completed clean-surface Cartesian matrix merely to reach site ordering.
Read the selected candidate case_id from the authoritative clean gate and retrieve that exact completed candidate from the original clean-surface run.
Require exactly one source summary matching the selected case_id and require that source row to be COMPLETE and role=candidate.
Use the exact frozen Stage A Quantum ESPRESSO engine and pseudopotential bundle already bound by the site-ordering protocol.
Run the four prospectively frozen sites top, bridge, fcc_hollow, and hcp_hollow with the unchanged primary and independent-audit rules.
If the clean gate is not PASS, stop with no site-ordering computation and no reinterpretation.
Kinetic or diffusion outcomes remain forbidden as selectors or tuners.
